notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 55-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.73, creatinine 0.79, hemoglobin 13, platelets 289, sodium 140, wbc 8; vitals dbp 65-69, heart_rate 82-88, map 83-86, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 119-124, spo2 96-97, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.8, hemoglobin 13, platelets 284, sodium 140, wbc 7.5; vitals dbp 64-70, heart_rate 83-88, map 82-87, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 117-121, spo2 96-97, temp 36.6-36.9
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 55-year-old female, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
